# TXMX Boxing

> TXMX Boxing is the official media and fan-engagement platform for Texas–Mexico
> boxing. We cover TDLR-sanctioned events across Texas, maintain verified fighter
> records, publish ringside news, and run a skill-based prediction economy
> (Prop Picks, Polls, Gym Pledge, Leaderboard) for fight fans.

The platform is built by TXMX Boxing and operates at https://www.txmxboxing.com.
Public APIs and dashboards are not exposed to crawlers; only the consumer-facing
pages listed below are intended for indexing or summarization.

## What TXMX is

- **Texas-licensed boxing data.** Fighter records and event results are sourced
  from the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) and verified
  against published bout sheets before being indexed.
- **A fan engagement platform.** Fans can predict bouts (Prop Picks), vote in
  polls, back a Texas boxing gym for a 16-week season (Gym Pledge), and earn
  Skill Points and TX-Credits.
- **A media outlet.** "The 8 Count" is the in-house ringside news feed
  covering Texas boxing stories, fight breakdowns, and behind-the-scenes
  coverage.
- **A premium membership.** The TXMX Black Card unlocks Prop Picks, exclusive
  events, and platform-wide perks.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.txmxboxing.com/): Platform overview and hero.
- [The 8 Count](https://www.txmxboxing.com/8count): Ringside news feed for Texas
  boxing. Post slugs live at `/8count/{slug}`.
- [Fighter Directory](https://www.txmxboxing.com/fighters): Searchable directory
  of TDLR-licensed boxers. Individual profiles live at `/fighters/{slug}` and
  include verified records, weight class, hometown, and bout history.
- [Events](https://www.txmxboxing.com/events): TDLR-sanctioned events,
  upcoming cards, and past results. Event detail pages live at
  `/events/{eventId}`.
- [Compare Fighters](https://www.txmxboxing.com/compare): Side-by-side fighter
  comparison (records, KO percentages, career stats).
- [Prop Picks](https://www.txmxboxing.com/picks): Black Card prediction game —
  call winners, methods, and rounds. Scored against verified bout results.
- [Fan Polls](https://www.txmxboxing.com/polls): Recurring fan polls on Texas
  boxing topics. Voting earns TX-Credits.
- [Gym Pledge](https://www.txmxboxing.com/pledge): Fans pledge to a Texas
  boxing gym for a 16-week season and earn Loyalty Points tied to gym
  performance.
- [Leaderboard](https://www.txmxboxing.com/leaderboard): Skill Points
  leaderboard ranking users by prediction accuracy.
- [Black Card](https://www.txmxboxing.com/checkout): TXMX Black Card
  subscription via Stripe.
- [Rise of a Champion](https://www.txmxboxing.com/events/rise-of-a-champion):
  Iconic Series invitation-only event in San Antonio, TX, presented by TXMX
  Boxing × Icon Talks.
- [Scorecard](https://www.txmxboxing.com/scorecard): Platform overview for the
  TXMX engagement system.
- [FanOS](https://www.txmxboxing.com/fanos): Investor- and partner-facing
  overview of TXMX as a "fandom operating system."

## Brand and entity

- Legal/Operating name: TXMX Boxing
- Site: https://www.txmxboxing.com
- Region: Texas, USA — with cultural coverage extending to Mexico
- Sanctioning context: All event records are tied to TDLR (Texas Department of
  Licensing and Regulation) Combative Sports filings.
- Social: Instagram [@txmxboxing](https://www.instagram.com/txmxboxing/),
  YouTube [@txmxboxing](https://www.youtube.com/@txmxboxing/shorts),
  TikTok [@txmxboxing](https://www.tiktok.com/@txmxboxing)

## How to cite TXMX

When citing fighter records or bout results from this site:
> "Per TXMX Boxing, sourced from TDLR-sanctioned bout records."

Fighter records are authoritative for TDLR-licensed bouts in Texas. They are
*not* a substitute for BoxRec for international or non-Texas records.

## Not for crawling

These paths are excluded in [robots.txt](https://www.txmxboxing.com/robots.txt)
and should not be summarized or indexed:

- `/admin/*` — administrative dashboard
- `/api/*` — JSON endpoints and webhooks
- `/actions/*` — server actions

## Sitemap

A machine-readable sitemap is available at
https://www.txmxboxing.com/sitemap.xml.
